commands: pc-scanner --config scanner.toml malware-checkpoints delete CHECKPOINT_ID --revision REVISION_TOKEN [--json]

behavior.deletion_selection: Exact lowercase 64-hex checkpoint ID and 64-hex revision token; no path/prefix/wildcard/bulk/force inputs.
behavior.revision: SHA256 of bounded file contents and opened file identity/size/write/change metadata; replacements and updates require relisting.
behavior.active_protection: Same malware_batch in-process lock and persistent .active.lock cross-process lock. Any scan or competing manager operation protects all deletions; lock acquisition waits at most about 50ms.
behavior.listing_during_busy: Reports a conservative scan_running protection flag, partial status and deletable=false. Another checkpoint management operation can also hold the lock.
behavior.scope: Only the selected file is removed; never scan files, scan history, other checkpoints, the checkpoint directory, or the shared lock.
behavior.metadata: New schema-2 saves include root_alias and relative target labels in both normal and selected retry persistence. Labels are display-only, never scan or deletion authorization.
behavior.legacy: Existing schema-1/2 state remains resumable; missing labels remain unknown. Corrupt but safely readable owned bounded state can be explicitly removed.
behavior.privacy: Relative labels only with --show-paths, escaped for text/JSON; no full checkpoint contents/findings shown; no engine required; no history append; missing stores are not created.
behavior.posix: Pin the private directory with a no-follow descriptor, open/stat/unlink relative to it, verify ownership/regular file/link count/local availability and revision.
behavior.windows: Open the reparse point itself with read/delete access as needed; verify opened file owner and attributes; delete only by validated handle with one-byte FILE_DISPOSITION_INFO. No path-delete fallback on API errors.
behavior.remaining_risk: MCP can still fill the fixed 16 slots again. This is an owner-operated recovery facility, not automatic quota eviction or prevention.
